description: Measure an incoming graph: nodes, edges, faces, components, leaves, junctions, total length. Forwards the graph on.
instructions:
Reads an incoming GRAPH (polylines — e.g. Skeleton branches / selected Graph) and measures its topology. Forwards the graph unchanged on the main output so it can continue downstream; every metric is also published as a value-OUT for wiring into Math / Output:
• nodes (unique vertices) · edges · faces (bounded regions, E−V+C) · components (disconnected sub-graphs) · leaves (degree-1 tips) · junctions (degree ≥3) · total length (m).

TIP: wire val-length or val-faces into an Output node's Metrics, or a Math node.
